svg.title: Capture & record…
svg.desc: The Capture & record… toolbar opens over a frozen screen. A region is dragged out, locked to 4:3 in the toolbar and captured to the Quick Access card. Then Text mode reads the link in a QR code, and Colour mode picks the blue of a chart bar with a magnifying loupe.

g.text: Last deploy 12 minutes ago · all checks passed
